name: Quicknode Blockchain Agent
description: Multi-chain blockchain infrastructure agent. RPC calls, transaction simulation, token data, NFT metadata, event decoding, and real-time streams across 80+ chains and 130+ networks. Autonomous account and endpoint provisioning via x402 or MPP, plus pay-per-request RPC via x402 or API key.

skills.name: Autonomous Endpoint Provisioning
skills.description: Create a Quicknode subscription and RPC endpoint without human signup. Two-step flow: POST https://www.quicknode.com/api/v1/agent/subscriptions (pay via x402 or MPP; POST with no body to receive a 402 listing plans and payment methods), then POST https://api.quicknode.com/v0/endpoints with the returned QN_* key to create a dedicated RPC endpoint on any of 80+ chains. Walkthrough: https://www.quicknode.com/agents/create-endpoint.md
examples: provision a Base mainnet RPC endpoint for me, I have USDC on Base
create a Quicknode subscription and give me an Ethereum endpoint
set up an autonomous Solana endpoint using my wallet

skills.name: Blockchain RPC Call
skills.description: Execute JSON-RPC calls on any supported chain. eth_call, eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionReceipt, getAccountInfo, etc.
examples: get the ETH balance of 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045
call eth_getBlockByNumber for latest block on Ethereum
get Solana account info for a wallet address

skills.name: Transaction Simulation
skills.description: Simulate transactions before broadcasting. Returns gas estimates, revert reasons, state changes, and asset transfers.
examples: simulate this swap transaction on Uniswap
estimate gas for a token transfer on Base
will this transaction revert?

skills.name: Token & Wallet Data
skills.description: Fetch token balances, metadata, prices, holders, and transfer history for any wallet across supported chains.
examples: get all token balances for this wallet on Ethereum
what tokens does this Solana wallet hold?
get transfer history for this address

skills.name: NFT Data & Metadata
skills.description: Retrieve NFT collections, ownership, metadata, traits, and transfer history.
examples: get NFTs owned by this wallet
fetch metadata for this NFT contract and token ID
who owns this NFT?

skills.name: Event & Log Decoding
skills.description: Fetch and decode smart contract events and logs. Filter by contract, topic, or block range.
examples: get all Transfer events from USDC contract in the last 100 blocks
decode the logs from this transaction hash
find all Swap events on Uniswap V3 in block range

skills.name: Real-time Blockchain Streams
skills.description: Subscribe to real-time blockchain data streams. New blocks, pending transactions, contract events, and custom filters.
examples: stream new blocks on Ethereum
monitor pending transactions to this contract
alert me when this wallet receives tokens

skills.name: Blockchain SQL Explorer
skills.description: Query indexed blockchain data using SQL. Blocks, transactions, logs, token transfers, and decoded contract data.
examples: find the top 10 gas spenders on Ethereum today
query all USDC transfers over $1M in the last 24 hours
count unique active wallets on Base this week

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Wallet-authenticated payment via x402 protocol. Used for per-request RPC access AND for autonomous subscription/endpoint provisioning (POST /api/v1/agent/subscriptions). USDC on Base, Solana, or Polygon. No account required.

Wallet-authenticated payment via Machine Payments Protocol (IETF draft). Used for per-request RPC access AND for autonomous subscription/endpoint provisioning (POST /api/v1/agent/subscriptions). PathUSD on Tempo or USDC on Solana. No account required.

apiKeySecurityScheme.name: X-API-Key
apiKeySecurityScheme.description: Quicknode API key from a standard plan.
